Prishata.note: King of Panchala; father of Drupada.

Drupada.note: King of Panchala; humiliated by his old classmate Drona, he won from a sacrifice a son to slay Drona and a daughter to wed the Pandavas.

Shikhandi.note: Child of Drupada, the reincarnation of Amba; born a girl and later made a man, whose presence let Bhishma be brought down, for Bhishma would not fight one born a woman.

Dhrishtadyumna.note: Son of Drupada, born from the sacrificial fire; commander of the Pandava army, fated to and did slay Drona.

Draupadi.note: Also Krishnaa and Yajnaseni; born of the sacrificial fire beside Dhrishtadyumna. Won by Arjuna, she became the shared wife of all five Pandavas and empress of Indraprastha. By name — humiliated and disrobed in the Kuru hall after the dice game, saved when Krishna made her sari endless; her vow not to bind her hair again till washed in Dushasana's blood; disguised as the maid Sairandhri in Virata's court, where she engineered Kichaka's death; and her sons by all five Pandavas (the Upapandavas), killed in their sleep by Ashvatthama after the war.

Satyajit.note: Son of Drupada; a Panchala warrior who died shielding Yudhishthira in the war.

Kshatradharma.note: Son of Dhrishtadyumna, of the Panchala line.

people.Arka: Son of Puruja, in the Ajamidha-to-Panchala chain. SB 9.21.
people.Bharmyashva: Son of Arka; father of five sons who divided the Panchala realm between them — Mudgala, Yavinara, Brihadvishva, Kampilla and Sanjaya. SB 9.21.
people.Mudgala: Eldest of Bharmyashva's five sons, eponym of the Mudgala gotra; husband of Indrasena (Nalayani, Damayanti's niece — see the Nalopakhyana notes) after her hundred trials of him.
people.Vadhryasva: Son of Mudgala; father of Divodasa of Panchala. RV 6.61. The tree keeps this reading against the Bhagavata's alternative, which has Mudgala father Divodasa directly.
people.Divodasa: King of Panchala; patron of the Rigvedic sage Bharadvaja, father of Mitrayu. RV 1.130, 6.26. Not Divodasa of Kashi — see PURANIC_LINEAGES.md Part V.
people.Mitrayu: Son of Divodasa of Panchala; father of Chyavana of Panchala.

ChyavanaP.name: Chyavana
ChyavanaP.note: Panchala king, son of Mitrayu. Not the sage Chyavana, Bhrigu's son and Sukanya's husband — see PURANIC_LINEAGES.md Part V.

SudasaP.name: Sudasa
SudasaP.note: King of Panchala; the Rigvedic Sudas Paijavana of the Battle of the Ten Kings (dasarajna), with Vasishtha as his priest. RV 7.18, 7.33, 7.83. Not the Ikshvaku Sudasa — see Part V.

SahadevaP.name: Sahadeva
SahadevaP.note: Panchala king, son of Sudasa. Not the Pandava Sahadeva.

people.Somaka: Panchala king, son of Sahadeva; his line runs down toward Drupada.
people.Yavinara: One of Bharmyashva's five sons among whom Panchala was divided.
people.Brihadvishva: One of Bharmyashva's five sons among whom Panchala was divided.
people.Kampilla: One of Bharmyashva's five sons among whom Panchala was divided; namesake of Kampilya, the Panchala capital.

SanjayaP.name: Sanjaya
SanjayaP.note: One of Bharmyashva's five sons among whom Panchala was divided. Not Sanjaya Gavalgani, Dhritarashtra's charioteer-narrator.

Ahalya.note: Twin of Divodasa in the royal Panchala line; also told as Brahma-born (the divine ray). Famed as the wife of Gautama, cursed and later redeemed.

Maudgalya.note: Eponym of the Maudgalya gotra: the Brahmin line of Mudgala’s descendants, distinct from the royal Panchala line carried by Vadhryasva.

Jantu.note: Somaka’s eldest son; offered in sacrifice, per the Mahabharata, so that Somaka might gain a hundred sons.

NilaP.name: Nila
NilaP.note: Son of Ajamidha by Nalini. Not Nila the vanara commander. SB 9.21.32
